source: CII VII.2, List of Plates (Part 2), printed pp. ix-xi = PDF pp. 12-15
method: Transcribed by Claude, 22 Oct 2026, by reading the scanned page images strip by strip (not OCR). Authors' spelling, transliteration and misprints kept as printed. Where the typeface's damaged 'y' prints like 'v' (e.g. 'fragmentarv', 'Udavāditva'), 'y' is restored and noted. Italic words (sarpabandha, Mahākumāra) are given in plain text. Not yet hand-verified by the user.
